pillar: Office of the City Building Official
ground_truth_reference_answer: To secure a Certified True Copy (CTC) of a Building Permit or related building documents from the OCBO Records Division, the applicant must submit: 1) Request Letter; 2) Photocopy of the Building Permit or reference details; 3) Photocopy of valid ID of owner with 3 specimen signatures; 4) Notarized SPA and processor's valid ID if represented; and 5) Original Affidavit of Loss if the original permit was lost. The statutory fee is PHP 50.00 per document (1 copy), paid at the City Treasurer's Office, with a standard turnaround time of 2 Days, 1 Hour, and 19 Minutes.
